rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the committee spec, not a candidate: the reference baselines of the two member specs in every slot, one member of each kind with weight one. No number was taken from the PSI-159 tables. The slot values are copied from the two baseline releases by tools/wsp/committee_edits.py, which chooses nothing. Data-informed candidates of acme_normal-wsp-v5 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
